adapter_projection_policy.location_catalogue: the complete frozen world location catalogue is carried by ProjectTwoReplayEpisode.known_location_ids in generator order; location identifiers never break ties
adapter_projection_policy.transition_rule: a replay transition is emitted only when two successive robot-visible locations differ; the first visible location and repeated same-location observations remain before-only anchors rather than fabricated relocations
adapter_projection_policy.actor_rule: visible_actor_map and visible_owner_probability are deterministically expanded to a controlled-noise categorical posterior without reading true_actor
adapter_projection_policy.action_trace_rule: every scored token binds whether a model-selected physical verification was executed plus the put-back location and first search location; internal promote/escrow bookkeeping is not counted as an external action
adapter_projection_policy.known_limit: snapshot observations that do not establish a visible location change are not consumed as relocation evidence by transition-only method cores; Gate B diagnoses arm distinguishability under this common compatible projection and does not claim method efficacy

gate_b_contract.distinguishability_threshold_basis: Author-chosen pre-validation thresholds reused from the corrected-instrument validity audit: every declared pair must disagree on at least 1% of scored predictions, and at least 20% of episodes must contain multiple arm trajectories. gate_b_contract.trace_attestation: every arm trace must be independently recomputed from the frozen source bundle in the custodian environment, match the supplied trace exactly, and carry an Ed25519 signature from the preregistered custodian key under cpswm.evaluation.structure_two.bound_arm_trace.v0.4
gate_b_contract.common_producer_requirement: all ten signed traces must name the same producer run id and producer source-bundle SHA-256

gate_b_contract.signature_limit: the custodian signature proves the trace exactly matches execution of the frozen adapter bundle; it does not prove that matched external-neighbor adapters reproduce official external code or that any arm is effective
